Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Walking is good, but your legs need their own exercise too. Try ten slow sit-to-stands today. 💪 In the fifth chapter of our Uncle Lim family story, Uncle Lim learns a dance step at his favourite kopitiam. His friends laugh and tell him to just sit, but then he needs two tries to get up from a low stool. Our pharmacist and our dietitian at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall show him a few easy moves to add to his week. Simple moves for older adults in Johor Bahru: Sit-to-stand from a sturdy chair, slowly, up to ten times Heel raises while holding the kitchen sink Dance to two favourite songs Ask us or your doctor before starting something new Come by our counter for a Minute Consult with no appointment, or ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling for meals that support an active routine. Find us on the Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru, daily from 10AM to 10PM.
